# UX & Accessibility Checklist: Home roll-up

**Purpose**: Validate that the UX, layout, loading, empty-state and accessibility **requirements** for `/home` are complete, unambiguous, consistent and objectively verifiable before implementation begins
**Created**: 2026-09-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/screens.md](../contracts/screens.md) · [research.md](../research.md) §E

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Layout & Composition Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the six surfaces' arrangement and their order both specified, or does the spec fix only the order and leave the visual layout to the implementer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the greeting's rendered wording specified beyond "names the viewer", so two implementations cannot produce different sentences? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the three stat cards' visible labels specified as text, so "a label naming what it counts" is verifiable rather than paraphrasable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements stated for what the page renders above the five Suspense boundaries while the actor is being resolved? [Coverage, Gap, contracts/screens.md §2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the viewport expectation ("desktop only, no breakpoint") stated as a requirement, or does it exist only in the screen contract? [Traceability, contracts/screens.md §4]

## Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK006 Can "the number MUST NOT be conveyed by size, colour or position alone" be objectively evaluated, given FR-001 fixes the cards by position? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "matching the layout it replaces" quantified for skeletons (row count, height, geometry), or left to reader judgement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, `OT-UX-005`]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "one quiet line" defined by more than its negations (no illustration, no marketing, no call to action) — is the actual text of each empty line specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-040, SC-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a visible focus indicator" defined with measurable criteria, or delegated to "the application's shared focus styling" without naming or bounding it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042, research.md E-1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the rendered form of the progress figure specified — text alone, or a bar with a text equivalent — and are its semantics stated if it is a bar? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019]

## Loading & Empty State Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is FR-038's three-placeholder-row reservation for the two unbounded sections (**Assigned to you**, **Your projects**), and its five and twenty rows for **Mentions** and **Recent activity**, carried into the screen contract's skeleton rows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-038, contracts/screens.md §2]
- [ ] CHK012 Is FR-038's geometry-not-row-count promise measurable as SC-011 states it — every element keeping its horizontal position and its own height, every section whose real row count differs from the count it reserved the only surfaces permitted to change height, and reflow below such a section the only movement any load may produce? [Measurability, Spec §FR-038, §FR-010, SC-011]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the empty-state requirements stated per section, or is one rule assumed to cover four sections whose row shapes differ in every field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the distinction between an empty section (one line) and a zero stat card (the digit `0`) stated unambiguously, so neither surface adopts the other's treatment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for a section that renders fewer rows than its bound (fewer than five mentions, fewer than twenty activity rows) without padding? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are the accessible names and heading levels of the four section regions specified, so the six surfaces FR-001 orders are navigable by heading? [Gap, Spec §FR-042, contracts/screens.md §4]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the accessible name of a navigating row specified — whether it comprises issue key, title and project name, or only one of them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-030, §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the `aria-busy` obligation on skeletons stated as a requirement, or does it appear only in the screen contract? [Traceability, contracts/screens.md §4, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the text equivalent for the unread state specified for read rows as well as unread ones, so state is not inferred from the absence of a dot? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, `OT-UX-018`]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the relative-time requirement specified beyond "a relative time" — its unit ladder, its locale, and whether a machine-readable absolute time accompanies it? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a keyboard traversal order specified across the six surfaces, or only per-row operability? [Coverage, Spec §FR-042, `OT-UX-017`]

## Edge Cases & Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK022 Are overflow or truncation requirements defined for long issue titles, project names and composed activity sentences? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for how the must-change-password banner interacts with Home's heading order and focus order? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the `project.status` values that may render beside a progress figure enumerated, so the status label has a defined vocabulary? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the decision not to render a comment's body in **Recent activity** carried by a requirement, or does it rest on an interpretive reading recorded only in research? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030, research.md E-3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK025 is the item most likely to fail review: it rests on an interpretive call `research.md` E-3 records as the design's only one. CHK012 no longer records a tension — FR-038 and SC-011 now bind geometry rather than row count, and reserve three placeholder rows for each unbounded section — and asks only whether that promise is stated measurably
